ucs.title: [LLM] Scattered Spider (Octo Tempest) helpdesk-driven MFA reset → attacker sign-in from new device
ucs.description: Hunts the signature Scattered Spider initial-access chain: a social-engineered helpdesk call that resets a target's password or registers a new MFA method, immediately followed by an interactive sign-in from a previously-unseen IP/device. This is the exact sequence MS-ISAC, CISA AA23-320A, and Microsoft (Octo Tempest) document as UNC3944's entry point into Caesars, MGM, Twilio, Reddit, and Coinbase.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Change where (All_Changes.action=modified All_Changes.object_category=user (All_Changes.change_type="authentication" OR All_Changes.command IN ("Reset user password","Update user","Update authentication phone method","Register security info","Disable Strong Authentication","User registered security info"))) by All_Changes.user All_Changes.src All_Changes.command All_Changes.result _time | `drop_dm_object_name("All_Changes")` | rename user as target_user | join type=inner target_user [| tstats `summariesonly` count values(Authentication.src) as login_src values(Authentication.src_user_agent) as ua values(Authentication.app) as app min(_time) as login_time from datamodel=Authentication where Authentication.action=success Authentication.signature_id IN ("UserLoggedIn","4624") earliest=-1d by Authentication.user Authentication.src _time | `drop_dm_object_name("Authentication")` | rename user as target_user] | eval delta=abs(login_time-_time) | where delta<3600 AND src!=login_src | table _time target_user command src login_src login_time delta ua app | sort - _time
ucs.kql:
// Scattered Spider helpdesk pretexting → fresh sign-in pivot
let WindowMinutes = 60m;
let HelpdeskOps = dynamic([
    "Reset user password",
    "Change user password",
    "Update user",
    "Update authentication phone method",
    "Disable Strong Authentication",
    "User registered security info",
    "Admin registered security info",
    "Reset password (by admin)"]);
let Resets =
    CloudAppEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where Application has_any ("Azure Active Directory","Microsoft Entra ID","Office 365")
    | where ActionType in~ (HelpdeskOps)
    | extend Target = tostring(parse_json(tostring(ActivityObjects))[0].Name)
    | project ResetTime = Timestamp, ActorUpn = AccountDisplayName, ActorIp = IPAddress,
              ActionType, Target, ActorIsAdmin = IsAdminOperation;
Resets
| join kind=inner (
    AADSignInEventsBeta
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where IsInteractive == true
    | where ErrorCode == 0
    | project SigninTime = Timestamp, AccountUpn, SignInIp = IPAddress,
              Country, City, DeviceName, AadDeviceId, Browser, UserAgent,
              DeviceTrustType, ConditionalAccessStatus, RiskLevelDuringSignIn
  ) on $left.Target == $right.AccountUpn
| where SigninTime between (ResetTime .. ResetTime + WindowMinutes)
| extend MinutesAfterReset = datetime_diff('minute', SigninTime, ResetTime)
| join kind=leftanti (
    AADSignInEventsBeta
    | where Timestamp between (ago(60d) .. ago(1d))
    | where ErrorCode == 0
    | summarize by AccountUpn, IPAddress
  ) on $left.AccountUpn == $right.AccountUpn, $left.SignInIp == $right.IPAddress
| project ResetTime, ActionType, ActorUpn, ActorIp, ActorIsAdmin,
          Target, MinutesAfterReset, SignInIp, Country, City,
          DeviceName, AadDeviceId, DeviceTrustType, Browser, UserAgent,
          ConditionalAccessStatus, RiskLevelDuringSignIn
| order by ResetTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Scattered Spider helpdesk pretexting → fresh sign-in pivot (Sentinel)
let WindowMinutes = 60m;
let HelpdeskOps = dynamic([
    "Reset user password",
    "Change user password",
    "Update user",
    "Update authentication phone method",
    "Disable Strong Authentication",
    "User registered security info",
    "Admin registered security info",
    "Reset password (by admin)"]);
let Resets =
    AuditLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where OperationName in~ (HelpdeskOps)
    | extend Target = tostring(TargetResources[0].userPrincipalName)
    | extend ActorUpn = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName)
    | extend ActorIp = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress)
    | project ResetTime = TimeGenerated, OperationName, ActorUpn, ActorIp, Target;
Resets
| join kind=inner (
    SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where IsInteractive == true
    | where ResultType == 0
    | extend DeviceId = tostring(DeviceDetail.deviceId)
    | extend DeviceTrust = tostring(DeviceDetail.trustType)
    | extend Country = tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion)
    | extend City = tostring(LocationDetails.city)
    | project SigninTime = TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, SignInIp = IPAddress,
              Country, City, DeviceId, DeviceTrust, UserAgent,
              ConditionalAccessStatus, RiskLevelDuringSignIn, AppDisplayName
  ) on $left.Target == $right.UserPrincipalName
| where SigninTime between (ResetTime .. ResetTime + WindowMinutes)
| extend MinutesAfterReset = datetime_diff('minute', SigninTime, ResetTime)
| join kind=leftanti (
    SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated between (ago(60d) .. ago(1d))
    | where ResultType == 0
    | summarize by UserPrincipalName, IPAddress
  ) on $left.UserPrincipalName == $right.UserPrincipalName, $left.SignInIp == $right.IPAddress
| project ResetTime, OperationName, ActorUpn, ActorIp,
          Target = UserPrincipalName, MinutesAfterReset,
          SignInIp, Country, City, DeviceId, DeviceTrust,
          UserAgent, ConditionalAccessStatus, RiskLevelDuringSignIn, AppDisplayName
| order by ResetTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:okta @evt.name:(user.account.reset_password OR user.mfa.factor.reset_all OR user.mfa.factor.deactivate OR user.mfa.factor.activate OR user.authenticator.update OR user.account.update_password) @outcome.result:SUCCESS
ucs.falcon_logscale_query: #event_simpleName=IdpAuthenticationLog (EventName=/user\.account\.reset_password/i OR EventName=/user\.mfa\.factor/i OR EventName=/(Update|Reset).*authentication/i OR EventName=/Reset user password/i) | groupBy([TargetUserPrincipal, ActorUserPrincipal, ActorIpAddress], function={ collect([EventName, _time]) | min(_time, as=ResetTime) }) | join({#event_simpleName=IdpAuthenticationLog EventName=/UserLoggedIn|SignInActivity/i AuthenticationResult=Success}, field=TargetUserPrincipal, key=UserPrincipal, include=[SourceIpAddress, _time, DeviceId, UserAgent], mode=inner) | _time - ResetTime < 3600 AND _time - ResetTime > 0 AND SourceIpAddress != ActorIpAddress | table([ResetTime, _time, TargetUserPrincipal, ActorUserPrincipal, ActorIpAddress, SourceIpAddress, DeviceId, UserAgent])
ucs.rationale: This is THE Scattered Spider signature - it is not a generic 'impossible travel' rule. The chain (1) helpdesk-class identity mutation followed by (2) a successful interactive sign-in within an hour from (3) an IP never previously seen for that user catches the exact tradecraft Microsoft attributes to Octo Tempest and CISA documented in AA23-320A. Generic ransomware crews don't call the helpdesk; A

ucs.title: [LLM] Scattered Spider RMM convergence: rapid install of multiple remote-access tools on a single host
ucs.description: Hunts the Scattered Spider tradecraft of layering multiple legitimate RMM/remote-access tools on the same victim host to maintain redundant access. CISA AA23-320A and Mandiant's UNC3944 reporting document this crew installing ScreenConnect, AnyDesk, Splashtop, TeamViewer, Pulseway, Tactical RMM, RustDesk, Fleetdeck and Ngrok in combination - 3+ on one host inside a short window is highly diagnostic of them specifically.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.process_name) as procs from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe","ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe","AnyDesk.exe","SRService.exe","SRManager.exe","TeamViewer_Service.exe","TeamViewer.exe","PulsewayService.exe","tacticalrmm.exe","MeshAgent.exe","rustdesk.exe","fleetdeck_agent.exe","ngrok.exe","LMI_Rescue.exe","g2mlauncher.exe","atera_agent.exe","AeroAdmin.exe","SplashtopStreamer.exe","strwinclt.exe","BeAnywhere.exe","action1_agent.exe","syncro.exe") by host Processes.user Processes.process_name _time | `drop_dm_object_name("Processes")` | bucket _time span=24h | stats dc(process_name) as rmm_count values(process_name) as rmm_tools values(cmdlines) as cmdlines values(user) as users by host _time | where rmm_count>=3 | sort - _time
ucs.kql:
// Scattered Spider RMM stacking - 3+ distinct remote-access tools on one host in 24h
let RmmExes = dynamic([
    "screenconnect.clientservice.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe",
    "anydesk.exe",
    "teamviewer.exe","teamviewer_service.exe",
    "pulsewayservice.exe",
    "tacticalrmm.exe",
    "meshagent.exe",
    "rustdesk.exe",
    "fleetdeck_agent.exe",
    "ngrok.exe",
    "lmi_rescue.exe","g2mlauncher.exe",
    "atera_agent.exe",
    "aeroadmin.exe",
    "splashtopstreamer.exe","strwinclt.exe",
    "beanywhere.exe",
    "action1_agent.exe",
    "syncro.exe",
    "connectwisecontrol.client.exe"]);
let ProcHits =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where tolower(FileName) in (RmmExes)
    | project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, FileName, FolderPath,
              ProcessCommandLine, AccountName, SHA256;
let FileHits =
    DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileRenamed")
    | where tolower(FileName) in (RmmExes)
    | project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, FileName, FolderPath,
              InitiatingProcessCommandLine, AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
              SHA256;
union ProcHits, FileHits
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| summarize DistinctTools = dcount(FileName),
            ToolsSeen = make_set(FileName, 20),
            SampleCmds = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 10),
            Users = make_set(AccountName, 10),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen = max(Timestamp)
            by DeviceId, DeviceName, bin(Timestamp, 1d)
| where DistinctTools >= 3   // 3+ distinct RMM binaries in 24h = high-fidelity Scattered Spider signal
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Scattered Spider RMM stacking (Sentinel - SecurityEvent 4688 + ImProcessCreate fallback)
let RmmExes = dynamic([
    "screenconnect.clientservice.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe",
    "anydesk.exe",
    "teamviewer.exe","teamviewer_service.exe",
    "pulsewayservice.exe",
    "tacticalrmm.exe",
    "meshagent.exe",
    "rustdesk.exe",
    "fleetdeck_agent.exe",
    "ngrok.exe",
    "lmi_rescue.exe","g2mlauncher.exe",
    "atera_agent.exe",
    "aeroadmin.exe",
    "splashtopstreamer.exe","strwinclt.exe",
    "beanywhere.exe",
    "action1_agent.exe",
    "syncro.exe",
    "connectwisecontrol.client.exe"]);
let FromSecEvent =
    SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | extend Exe = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, '\\')[-1]))
    | where Exe in (RmmExes)
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | project TimeGenerated, Host = Computer, Exe,
              CmdLine = CommandLine, User = SubjectUserName;
let FromAsim =
    ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | extend Exe = tolower(tostring(split(TargetProcessName, '\\')[-1]))
    | where Exe in (RmmExes)
    | where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
    | project TimeGenerated, Host = DvcHostname, Exe,
              CmdLine = TargetProcessCommandLine, User = ActorUsername;
union FromSecEvent, FromAsim
| summarize DistinctTools = dcount(Exe),
            ToolsSeen = make_set(Exe, 20),
            SampleCmds = make_set(CmdLine, 10),
            Users = make_set(User, 10),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
            by Host, bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| where DistinctTools >= 3
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Scattered Spider RMM Tool Stacking
id: 9a3f51e2-6d8a-4b6b-9b6e-7c2e5a4d1f01
status: experimental
description: Detects execution of any of the remote-access tools repeatedly observed in CISA AA23-320A / Microsoft Octo Tempest reporting on Scattered Spider (UNC3944) intrusions. Three or more distinct tools on the same host inside 24h is the diagnostic signal - chain in a SIEM aggregation.
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/09
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-320a
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2023/10/25/octo-tempest-crosses-boundaries-to-facilitate-extortion-encryption-and-destruction/
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe'
      - '\ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe'
      - '\ConnectWiseControl.Client.exe'
      - '\AnyDesk.exe'
      - '\TeamViewer.exe'
      - '\TeamViewer_Service.exe'
      - '\PulsewayService.exe'
      - '\tacticalrmm.exe'
      - '\MeshAgent.exe'
      - '\rustdesk.exe'
      - '\fleetdeck_agent.exe'
      - '\ngrok.exe'
      - '\LMI_Rescue.exe'
      - '\g2mlauncher.exe'
      - '\atera_agent.exe'
      - '\AeroAdmin.exe'
      - '\SplashtopStreamer.exe'
      - '\strwinclt.exe'
      - '\BeAnywhere.exe'
      - '\action1_agent.exe'
      - '\syncro.exe'
  condition: selection
fields:
  - Image
  - CommandLine
  - User
  - ComputerName

ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) @EventID:(1 OR 4688) @Image:(*\ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe OR *\screenconnect.clientservice.exe OR *\ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe OR *\AnyDesk.exe OR *\anydesk.exe OR *\TeamViewer.exe OR *\teamviewer.exe OR *\TeamViewer_Service.exe OR *\PulsewayService.exe OR *\pulsewayservice.exe OR *\tacticalrmm.exe OR *\MeshAgent.exe OR *\meshagent.exe OR *\rustdesk.exe OR *\RustDesk.exe OR *\fleetdeck_agent.exe OR *\ngrok.exe OR *\Ngrok.exe OR *\LMI_Rescue.exe OR *\g2mlauncher.exe OR *\atera_agent.exe OR *\AeroAdmin.exe OR *\SplashtopStreamer.exe OR *\splashtopstreamer.exe OR *\strwinclt.exe OR *\BeAnywhere.exe OR *\action1_agent.exe OR *\syncro.exe OR *\ConnectWiseControl.Client.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query: #event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\(screenconnect\.clientservice|screenconnect\.windowsclient|connectwisecontrol\.client|anydesk|teamviewer(_service)?|pulsewayservice|tacticalrmm|meshagent|rustdesk|fleetdeck_agent|ngrok|lmi_rescue|g2mlauncher|atera_agent|aeroadmin|splashtopstreamer|strwinclt|beanywhere|action1_agent|syncro)\.exe$/i | regex("\\\\(?<rmm>[^\\\\]+\\.exe)$", field=ImageFileName, strict=false) | groupBy([aid, ComputerName], function={ count(field=rmm, distinct=true, as=DistinctTools) | collect([rmm], as=ToolsSeen) | collect([CommandLine, UserName], multival=true) | min(_time, as=FirstSeen) | max(_time, as=LastSeen) }) | DistinctTools >= 3 | sort(LastSeen, order=desc)
